page.layout: One block of verse in a single column, with a running head and page number at the top; no notes in the margins.

main_text.l: Vernas, quibus herus contigit Dei timens,
Nec qui magis fua fatagat familia
Parere nos æquum est tibi: nec gratius
Quicquam esse nobis censeas quàm commodis
Parata nobis cuncta sunt, mox ibimus.
Quid me, precor, relinquitis? me sumite
Vobis comitem, nostros vt aspiciam greges.
Isaace mane, nec adibus patris procul
Sed firmior postquam tibi atas auxerit

page.notes: Catchword-like marks at the foot left out; the first verse line includes the word "Dεstros" and "Dεlut" as printed, which are doubtful readings for "Dεstros" (Pastros/Pastores) and "Dεlut" (Velut); "Vελit" is likely "Vult". Some words in the bottom line are damaged by stains and may be incomplete.
